title: Round 8 stream B: BELOW's mouse drag orbits the chase camera round ISAO and never writes his yaw or pitch (W S A D Space Shift stay his, along his heading); released, the view holds 0.8 s and returns to his back
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, note 4 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-round-8-seven-notes-design.md, stream B): 'the final sinkhole mission, BELOW: moving the mouse should move the camera but without hindering the Isao movement'. Round 7 stream D (entry 2026-11-05-round-7-stream-d-below-s-chase-camera-never-leaves-isao-s-back-the-mouse-does-nothing) had taken the mouse away entirely (the old pointer-lock look turned ISAO: 0.8 rad for a 400 px drag); this gives the mouse back as a camera-only orbit and keeps round 7's chase rules (follow 6 /s, the boom clipped along his ray, the view along the camera's own azimuth). Branch round-8-below off d67d5fb7; the cave in kai-denrei/stalheart-cave, branch round-8-below off round-7-below ace9566, re-imported with scripts/import-below.mjs: below/ is pinned at the cave's 55fbce5.
outcome: MEASURED FIRST (cave scratch/r8-below/orbit-probe.mjs, headless on the cave's own server under the lock): a 400 px CDP drag over #view (8 moves of 50 px, 10 px down each) with W held for 1 s inside it, at s 27.5 (the first corridor) and s 8 (the elbow under the throat), then W 1 s / A 1 s with no mouse. BEFORE (ace9566): the drag moved the camera's azimuth 0.0004 rad at most off his yaw (the mouse did nothing), yaw / pitch unchanged, W inside it flew him along his heading (0.0000 rad off); W/A kept the view within 0.196 rad and the boom within 0.206 rad of his heading (the follow lag). AFTER (55fbce5): the drag swings the view 1.800 rad round him at both places (the boom's own azimuth 1.735 / 1.751 rad, the wall clipping its reach), yaw, pitch and position unchanged (yaw delta 0, pitch delta 0), W held inside the drag (1 s of harness steps, plus the headless page's own frames) flies him 7.86 m / 7.55 m along HIS heading (0.0000 rad off it, not the view's); after the release the view holds and returns: 0.0025 rad off his heading 2 s after (headless rAF frames add real time to the harness's advance, so the pure model's number is the bar: orbitStep leaves a 1.8 rad orbit 0.039 rad off 2 s after the release); W/A with no mouse unchanged (0.196 / 0.206 rad). The cave's browser-suite step: a 200 px drag 0.900 rad round him, the 400 px drag 1.800, W 4.26 m along his heading, back to 0.0266 rad 2 s after the release, no pointer lock. HOW: the cave's src/flight.js ORBIT { yawRate 0.0045, pitchRate 0.0045 rad/px, hold 0.8 s, k 3.2, maxYaw pi } and a pure orbitStep(orbit, dx, dy, dt, { dragging, basePitch }) (the drag's pixels swing the orbit, its pitch clamped so the chase pitch plus it stays in [CHASE.above, CHASE.below], no decay while the button is held, after `hold` s of stillness 1 - exp(-k dt) back to zero); src/isao.js adds the orbit only to the azimuth and pitch the camera is built on (az = camYaw + orbit.yaw), the rest of round 7's chase unchanged; src/main.js: mousedown on #view starts a drag, mousemove gathers movementX/Y for the next step's orbitStep, mouseup / blur / pause / a buttonless move end it, nothing a mouse sends writes yaw or pitch, no pointer lock, the door's first DOOR.tilt seconds ignore the drag (doorLook owns the view). Copy: the start card's FLIGHT_KEYS 'W S FLY · A D TURN · SPACE SHIFT UP DOWN · MOUSE · LOOK AROUND' (the game's --descent-carcass reads it from below/), the HUD 'DRAG / ↑ ↓ LOOK', the pause help, the briefing footer 'KEYBOARD + MOUSE', README.
alternatives: The design's decay k 2.6: overturned by its own bar; 1.8 rad x exp(-2.6 x 1.2) leaves the camera 0.08 rad off his heading 2 s after a 400 px drag (the bar is 0.05); k 3.2 leaves 0.039 with the design's 0.8 s hold kept.

Pointer lock (or a hovering-pointer orbit with no button): rejected; the lock's loss used to pause the game, it is what round 7 removed with the mouse, and a CDP drag cannot exercise it; a hover orbit would swing the view whenever the hand rests on the mouse. The drag needs neither. Not checked headed by hand: the owner's feel is still open.

The orbit kept until the next drag (no decay): rejected; the camera returning to his back on its own is what round 7's note asked for, and the keys stay meaningful against the view the player sees most of the time.
evidence: cave scratch/r8-below (not committed): orbit-probe.mjs, before.json (ace9566), after.json (55fbce5's code), browser-*.log

cave test/flight.test.mjs: orbitStep's clamps (half a turn, the chase pitch range from four bases), no decay while held for 10 s, the hold, under 0.05 rad 2 s after the release, a new move restarting the hold; main.js's three mouse handlers write no yaw or pitch and take no pointer lock; isao.js adds the orbit to the azimuth only. Cave npm test 58/58, npm run check.
